audit.whatIsWrong: Labelled TRICKY at 7.5/10 on a 51.72% win rate over 29 games, and the prose itself says 'it trends even'.
audit.why: A coin-flip win rate and a page that repeatedly describes the lane as a read war do not support 7.5/10.
audit.corrected: diffRating to 5.5/10 with the difficulty and final-rating lines following. 'diff' (TRICKY, 6 chars) and 'tone' (#ff8b3d, 7 chars) cannot be replaced inside the +/-10% band.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item and late spikes attribute Riven's power to 'ult-empowered Q resets'.
audit.why: Riot on Blade of the Exile: 'Riven empowers her keepsake weapon with energy, and gains Attack Damage and Range. During this time, she also gains the ability to use Wind Slash, a powerful ranged attack, once.' It grants AD, range and one Wind Slash. Nothing in it resets Broken Wings.
audit.corrected: Spikes now name Blade of the Exile's bonus AD and range plus the single Wind Slash, which is what actually changes at her item timing.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive cooldown structure and one hard displacement were both absent. Broken Wings is three casts on a single 13-second cooldown; the third cast knocks back.
audit.why: Riot: 'Riven lashes out in a series of strikes. This ability can be reactivated three times in a short time frame with the third hit knocking back nearby enemies.' cooldown 13 (flat). That means her mobility is spent-tracked, not per-cast — after the third she has only Valor (10/9/8/7/6s). And the third-cast knockback is a displacement that can shove Galio out of Shield of Durand's 275 taunt radius before the release.
audit.corrected: Both stated: track the Broken Wings bar, punch once it and Valor are spent; expect the third cast to displace you out of your own taunt range.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization says 'Oblivion Orb early — his healing fights your trade math', breakdown.late says 'anti-heal stays core', and loading says 'Anti-heal if he sustains'.
audit.why: Riven has no heal anywhere in her kit — Runic Blade charges autos, Broken Wings and Ki Burst are damage, Valor is a shield, Blade of the Exile is stats. _missing-interactions does not list needs-antiheal for galio vs riven either. Buying Grievous Wounds here is wasted gold.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal removed from all three and replaced with armour/HP guidance.

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown block named Ki Burst with no number and ignored Broken Wings entirely.
audit.why: Ki Burst 11/10/9/8/7s, Valor 10/9/8/7/6s, Broken Wings 13s flat, against Justice Punch at 11/10/9/8/7s. Riven is resourceless, so nothing in her kit costs her anything — the only currency in the lane is cooldowns, which makes the numbers load-bearing.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, winCon, phases[2], loading and early.

edits.before: Riven owns the very start: at level 1 you have one ability and no engage, so her Q dash all-in and E shield-dash punish you for free. Concede the opening and farm with the tips of your Winds of War windblasts. Don't channel W early to 'tank' her trades, she's full AD so Shield of Durand's magic-amplified reduction barely matters, and she'll just dash around the released taunt. Your window opens at level 3: once Q-W-E are online, the tornado pokes the wave and your W-release taunt into the E knock-up can lock her if she steps in to commit her combo.
edits.after: Riven owns the very start: at level 1 you have one ability and no engage, so Broken Wings and the Valor shield-dash punish you for free — and she pays no resource for any of it while your Q costs 60 mana. Concede the opening and farm with the tips of your Winds of War windblasts. Don't charge W early to 'tank' her trades; she's full AD, so Shield of Durand's magic-amplified reduction barely matters and she dashes around the released taunt. Your window opens at level 3: with Q-W-E online, poke with the tornado and chain the W-taunt release into the E knock-up when she steps in.

edits.before: This is your steadiest stretch, but it's a read war, not a stomp. Bait her to commit her W (Ki Burst) stun and her E shield, then release Shield of Durand to taunt and E through her while her gap-closers are spent, that's your only clean punish since she sidesteps skillshots all day. At 6 don't tunnel the duel: Hero's Entrance is worth more shipping pressure to another lane or back-loading the landing knock-up and taunt onto her engage. Respect that a fed Riven baits the taunt with a Q dash and resets her Broken Wings combo before you recover.
edits.after: This is your steadiest stretch, but it's a read war, not a stomp. Her whole commit runs off Broken Wings — three casts on one 13-second cooldown — so once the third one lands she has only Valor to leave on. Bait Ki Burst (11s at rank 1) and Valor, then release Shield of Durand to taunt and E through her while both are spent. At 6 don't tunnel the duel: Hero's Entrance is worth more shipping pressure to another lane. And respect the third Broken Wings — the knockback can shove you out of your own 275-range taunt before it releases.

edits.before: It trends even and your value is utility, not the 1v1. Riven with a first item, boots and ult-empowered Q resets out-trades you if you channel W predictably, so save the taunt for her engage, not as poke. Your R is the swing: flank a fight, drop the knock-up taunt on her and a carry, and let your team convert. Alone, she kites your cooldowns and bursts you inside her combo window. Win the map, don't try to win the sidelane against her.
edits.after: It trends even and your value is utility, not the 1v1. With a first item, boots and Blade of the Exile's bonus AD and range, she out-trades you if you charge W predictably, so save the taunt for her commit and remember Wind Slash is a ranged finisher she gets once per ult. Your R is the swing: flank a fight, drop the knock-up taunt on her and a carry, and let your team convert. Win the map, don't try to win the sidelane.

notes: The anti-heal template had fired on a champion with zero healing in her kit — three separate strings told the user to buy Grievous Wounds against Riven. Worth checking whether the same template fired on other no-heal enemies across the site. The packet's suspectNames for this matchup ('Save Shield of Durand', 'Shield of Durand's') are false positives — correct Riot name. Galio's Justice Punch carries a bogus derived 'terrain' flag in the kit library (Riot's description has no terrain), so no terrain claim was written. I did not claim that Broken Wings' third-cast knockback interrupts a Shield of Durand charge — Riot's text establishes the displacement but not the channel interaction, and needsResearch is empty, meaning unknown; I stated only the range consequence, which is geometry.
